 PETALING JAYA: Malakoff Corp Bhd has appointed deputy chief financial officer Nurshazwani Abd Malek as its covering chief financial officer, effective Dec 1.
 In a statement, the multinational energy generation and environmental solutions company said Nurshazwani will assume the role on an interim basis following the departure of Mohd Nazersham Mansor, who will step down as chief financial officer on Nov 30, 2026 to pursue other career opportunities.
 Separately, the company also announced the appointment of Aznita Abdul Aziz as an independent non-executive director with immediate effect.
 “Aznita brings approximately 26 years of experience in the oil and gas industry, primarily within the PETRONAS group of companies, spanning risk management, strategic planning, portfolio management, treasury operations and economic evaluation.
 “She began her career with PETRONAS Trading Sdn Bhd before joining Petroliam Nasional Bhd, where she held a number of senior positions including senior manager of gas supply origination, head of portfolio risk management and head of strategic planning and portfolio management.”
